issues_confirmed: Ctrl_Click_New_Tab/content.js:39-40 - anchor branch returns early for any element inside a[href], so plain links are routed through window.open at :58; native Ctrl+Click opens a background tab while window.open focuses the new tab, making this a focus steal on every site under <all_urls>.

Ctrl_Click_New_Tab/content.js:39-40 - the same early return shadows the SPA fallbacks at :42-54: <a href="#" onclick="..."> matches a[href], toAbsoluteUrl('#') returns null at :11, and the function returns null without ever reaching the onclick extraction at :54. Same for href="javascript:..." via :12.

Ctrl_Click_New_Tab/content.js:40 - for <a href="">, getAttribute('href') is the empty string (falsy), so it falls back to anchor.href, which resolves to the current page; Ctrl+Click opens a duplicate of the page you are already on.

Auto_Scroll_shorts/content.js:284 - tryClickNextOverlayButton('overlay-poll') is called from a bare 1300 ms setInterval (:275-285) and its guards at :195 check only enabled / isGokuSeriesPage / debounceReady; no check of currentTime, duration or ended. On a series page with a visible next control it clicks on arrival and chains onward.

Auto_Scroll_shorts/content.js:26-28 - debounceReady requires 1200 ms (SETTINGS.minAdvanceIntervalMs, :6) since the last advance, but the overlay poll interval is 1300 ms (GOKU.overlayClickRetryMs, :17), so the debounce never throttles the poll.

Waitlist_Display_Chrome/content.js:73 - the regex /Est\.\s*wait:\s*(\d+)\s*person/i does not match 'people', so the Chrome build silently surfaces nothing once the queue reads '2 people'. Firefox's regex at content.js:5 handles both via (?:person|people).

Waitlist_Display_Chrome/content.js:130-135 - the MutationObserver is undebounced and calls updateDisplay on every mutation record batch; extractWaitNumber at :69-77 then walks every span/div/p/li reading full-subtree textContent, with no leaf-node skip or length cap. Firefox debounces this to 250 ms (:37-40) and skips containers (:16-23).
Waitlist_Display_Firefox/content.js:31 - const newTitle = n || ORIGINAL_TITLE writes a bare digit with no marker, unlike Chrome's formatTitle at :64-66 which writes an hourglass prefix.
Waitlist_Display_Chrome/service_worker.js - the entire file is two comment lines; the manifest.json:17-19 background block that loads it is unnecessary under MV3.
Waitlist_Display_Firefox/manifest.json:18 - gecko id is still the placeholder queue-wait-tab-title@your-domain.com.

playback_speed_controller/manifest.json:17 - content_scripts matches *://*.youtube.com/* with no path restriction, and the 1 s interval at content.js:328-341 calls createUI() unconditionally; createUI's only guard at :180 is panel existence, never a <video> check, so the panel renders on the YouTube homepage, search and subscriptions (isVisible defaults true at :195).

playback_speed_controller/content.js:180 vs :274 - the getElementById existence check precedes the await chrome.storage.local.get at :186 while the appendChild is at :274, so two createUI() calls inside that window (interval plus the toolbar path at :322) both pass the guard, appending two panels and registering the :293 keydown listener twice, which makes ']' step speed by 0.2x.

Auto_Scroll_shorts/content.js:31 - the second clause (location.hostname !== 'www.youtube.com') is unreachable because /youtube\.com$/ already matches www.youtube.com; and manifest.json:8 only matches https://www.youtube.com/* and https://goku.sx/*, so the permissive host checks at :31 and :36 never come into play.
README.md:50 - install steps say to load 'Waitlist Display Firefox' (with spaces), but commit e495b44 renamed the folder to Waitlist_Display_Firefox, so the path does not exist.
README.md:33-36 - documents a fifth 'Remove Sponsors (Placeholder)' extension as an empty directory; no Remove_Sponsors/ exists in the tree.
README.md:54-77 - a second 'TODO List & Future Enhancements' list that contradicts todo.md, still proposing the unified manager popup that todo.md has dropped.

README.md - never documents Ctrl+Shift+Y (Auto_Scroll_shorts/content.js:302-309), the only way to disable auto-advance, nor that the speed panel is toggled by the toolbar button (playback_speed_controller/background.js:1).

verdict: Close to finished, and moving. Two of the five items from the last review shipped and were verified, so the loop is working. 976 lines of vanilla JS with no dependency rot and clean syntax across all 7 files. One bug genuinely deserves attention: the Ctrl_Click_New_Tab anchor branch runs on <all_urls> and is wrong in both directions at once, degrading ordinary browsing while failing the SPA case it was written for - a ~4-line fix. After that and the stale README, four of the five extensions are done. The fifth, Auto_Scroll_shorts, is half-targeted at goku.sx, which has now been unreachable from this machine twice in 12 days; the owner should check it in a browser, because if it is gone the right move is deleting 165 lines rather than fixing them.
